subject: Request: One-off extension & credit top-up for Iona Therapeutics prototype
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Laura Moss <laura.moss@iona-thera.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, Oct 1, 2028 at 3:12 PM -0700
Subject: Request: One-off extension & credit top-up for Iona Therapeutics prototype

Hi Laura / team —

Quick note to surface a blocker and ask for exec approval: Iona's prototype integration with the on-prem adapter has hit a compliance gating issue that will push the PoC past the standard PLG 30-day window. Engineering estimates an additional 6 weeks (45 days) of runway to finish the adapter and complete end-to-end performance tests.

Ask:
- One-off top-up of complimentary credits: $20,000 (token-equivalent)
- Extension of PoC window: +45 days beyond current expiration

Why this matters:
- Iona is doing an on-prem integration that once completed will be a full-production use case for Redwood Private (regulated healthcare).
- Current utilization: ~120k tokens/day during integration tests; we expect a spike to ~400k/day during validation.
- Conversion signal: CTO has committed to an expedited procurement path if the adapter proves stable; estimated ARR potential: $1.2M ARR (year 1).

Attachments: iona-poc-scope.pdf (scope + timeline), integration-runbook.xlsx (technical blockers).

I know this is outside standard PLG limits; looping in Jonas and Marissa for quick internal review and an ask for exec sign-off. If leadership can authorize a one-off, we will require Deal Desk to log the exception and Legal to confirm data handling MSA addendum.

Next steps I propose if approved:
1) Send an updated trial token allocation to Iona and extend the console expiry.
2) Send DocuSign MSA addendum for regs.
3) Put a 30-day check-in milestone with Success and Engineering for go/no-go.

Thanks — I can hop on a 15-min call with anyone to walk through the timeline.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, Oct 1, 2028 at 4:03 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-off extension & credit top-up for Iona Therapeutics prototype

Evelyn —

Thanks for the context. A couple quick asks before we escalate to Aditya:
- Can you quantify current spend to date on the PoC (tokens consumed, any ancillary infra billed)?
- Confidence level: what’s the probability this converts in 90 days?
- Any legal/procurement blockers on Iona’s side (PO timeline)?

If we have a clear conversion path and a signed commitment timeline from Iona’s CTO, I’m comfortable pushing an exception to Deal Desk for exec approval.

—Jonas
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Laura Moss <laura.moss@iona-thera.com>
Date: Mon, Oct 1, 2028 at 6:18 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-off extension & credit top-up for Iona Therapeutics prototype

Jonas — thanks. Quick data dump below to address the asks.

- Spend to date: ~3.6M tokens (~$2,400 equivalent under PLG rates), primarily for integration smoke tests.
- Expected incremental spend if adapter delivered: additional ~12M tokens over 6 weeks (~$8,000). The $20k ask includes buffer for performance tuning and a short validation burst (stress tests).
- Conversion confidence: CTO (Laura) verbally committed to initiating procurement if the adapter shows <200ms P95 latency and no data exfiltration flags; probability estimate: 65% within 90 days.
- Iona procurement timeline: CTO confirmed PO within 4–6 weeks post-validation; Legal says review of MSA addendum will take 5 business days once DocuSign is sent.

Risks:
- If the adapter shows regulatory gaps, they will pause and re-prioritize (low likelihood but material).
- This is an out-of-band credit request; we will request Deal Desk to mark as one-off to prevent automatic renewals.

I’ve attached the runbook and scope for internal review. If you’re good, can you route to Aditya with your recommendation?

—Evelyn
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, Oct 2, 2028 at 8:52 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-off extension & credit top-up for Iona Therapeutics prototype

Team —

Appreciate the clear ask and the data. I will approve a conditional one-off, with the following limits and controls:

Approval summary (executive):
- Credit top-up approved: up to $15,000 token-equivalent (not to exceed this amount).
- Trial extension approved: +30 days beyond current expiry (not the requested 45).

Conditions (required before activation):
1) Signed DocuSign MSA addendum or SOW that contains the on-prem adapter clause (no trial activation until signed). DocuSign link to be attached to Deal Desk ticket.
2) Deal Desk must log this as a one-off exception and set an automatic expiration that reverts tokens if not converted by extension end.
3) Success team must perform the 30-day check-in and confirm go/no-go metrics (P95 latency, security scan results).

Evelyn: route the DocuSign link to legal and to me. Jonas: please confirm Deal Desk ticket number for audit trail.

Once the three items above are satisfied, Finance will provision the credit. I want a brief exec stub in HubSpot stating rationale and expected ARR.

—Aditya
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Laura Moss <laura.moss@iona-thera.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, Oct 2, 2028 at 11:05 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-off extension & credit top-up for Iona Therapeutics prototype

Thanks Aditya — we’ll proceed on those terms. Laura — per Aditya’s note, we will:
1) Send the MSA addendum via DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.net/exec/abcd1234). Please sign when convenient; Legal expects the review to be rapid.
2) If signed, Finance will provision up to $15,000 in trial credits and extend the console for 30 days.
3) Success will schedule a 30-day technical check with Iona’s engineering team (I’ll coordinate).

Attaching the scope and runbook again for your engineers. We appreciate the partnership and want to make this low-friction to get to procurement.

Evelyn

Attachments: iona-poc-scope.pdf, integration-runbook.xlsx
